title: LikenessUse
description: LIKENESS-01. One time another household adult made a picture or video that looks like this person (with a saved style of them or from a photo of them). The subject sees these rows, and only the subject: they are the "Likeness use" log on the person's own settings page, and each one also sends the subject a notification. No prompt, picture or file is stored here.

way.description: style: a saved style (LoRA) of the person. photo: an uploaded photo of the person.

adult_content.description: Whether the request fell under the adult-content switch, which needed the subject's second consent.

source.description: Where the request was made; this is the record provenance.
